worldcombat.skill.firepledge.summary: Drive a Fire Pledge into chosen ground: a pillar of fire erupts, burning through everyone inside and setting them alight, and the base leaves a burning pledge scar. If a grass or water pledge scar already lies near the point, the vows answer: the strike is far heavier and the ground becomes a sea of fire (fire + grass) or raises a rainbow (fire + water).
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.description: The pillar erupts at the chosen point and deals %1$s special damage to every enemy inside.
The column is %1$s blocks across and %2$s blocks tall; anyone caught is set burning for %3$s.
The base leaves a burning pledge scar, %1$s blocks across, lasting %2$s; enemies standing on it keep burning.

If a grass or water pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks, the two vows resonate: this strike deals ×%2$s and the ground becomes a sea of fire (fire + grass) or raises a rainbow (fire + water, healing allies inside).
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.fierce.on: Fierce vow: power ×1.12, a thicker column, cooldown +12, but the scar lasts only 70% as long.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.fierce.off: Slow vow: power ×0.96, scar ×1.25, shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.0: Raise a fire pillar on distant ground
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.1: Seal a patch of ground with a burning pledge scar
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.2: Combine with a grass or water pledge into a sea of fire or a rainbow
On (fierce vow): power ×1.12, a thicker column, cooldown +12, but the scar lasts only 70% as long — burns harder, lingers less. Off (slow vow): power ×0.96, scar ×1.25, shorter cooldown — less damage, but the ground keeps burning longer.
The companion only raises a fire pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first. Lower for close work, higher to light fires from afar.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
